common.intro: AspectCut is a free tool to resize video online. It processes files locally in your browser with WebCodecs; videos are not uploaded to a server.

about.metaDescription: Learn how AspectCut processes videos client-side using the browser's built-in WebCodecs engine and local hardware memory.
about.whyP1: Traditional online video converters rely on a legacy cloud-server architecture. Users are forced to upload massive video files across slow broadband uplinks, wait in multi-minute server queues, and suffer intrusive watermark badges unless they purchase costly recurring subscriptions.
about.whyP2: Modern desktop and mobile hardware possesses powerful multi-core processors and hardware-accelerated media decoders that sit idle during browsing. AspectCut inverts the conversion paradigm: we use WebCodecs, the video engine built into modern browsers. Your browser decodes, reframes, crops, filters, and encodes your MP4 video entirely within local memory.

arch.v: WebCodecs, the browser's native video API, via the open-source Mediabunny library.
Uses your device's video encoder and decoder when available.
Even-integer macroblock truncation (Mod2) compliant with YUV 4:2:0 subsampling.
Automatic audio copy when the codec already matches, preventing generational audio compression loss.
0 bytes of video or audio data sent over the internet.

about.teamMission: Empowering video creators with fast, private, client-side browser tools that eliminate slow cloud queues, privacy leaks, and subscription watermarks.

checklist: Ensure hardware acceleration is enabled in browser settings
Verify you are on the latest version of Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox
For files over 200MB, ensure at least 4GB of available RAM

privacy.metaDescription: How AspectCut executes 100% in-browser video processing using WebCodecs. Your videos are never uploaded to any remote server.
privacy.h1: Your Video Never Leaves Your Device
privacy.intro: AspectCut was built with a fundamental architectural constraint: zero server-side file transmission.
privacy.localText: All video matrix operations and audio demuxing run entirely inside your browser's virtual machine sandbox.
privacy.cloudText: We operate zero video databases, zero object stores (S3/GCS), and zero remote rendering clusters.
privacy.verifyText: You do not need to take our word for it. Open your browser's Network Inspector ({code}), select a video, and press Convert. You will observe that zero bytes of video payload are transferred over HTTP POST/PUT. The only external assets requested are the static WebCodecs binary assets cached on your first visit.
privacy.analyticsText: We employ privacy-first, cookieless analytics strictly to monitor page visit volumes and error rates. We do not set tracking cookies, build behavioral ad profiles, or sell any user data.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions regarding our browser sandbox boundaries or enterprise deployments, reach out directly to {email}.
